data.one_liner: High-performance JavaScript engine plugin for Flutter with QuickJS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance JavaScript engine out of the box in Flutter across multiple platforms. Supports evaluating scripts, automatic type conversion between Dart and JavaScript, callbacks, promises, modules, and a native fetch API.
use_when: You need to run JavaScript code inside a Flutter application.
You want to execute scripts with support for memory limits, execution timeouts, and async promises.
avoid_when: You are running heavy scripts that require full browser DOM APIs beyond what QuickJS provides.
You want a pure Dart interpreter without native platform dependencies.
strengths: Up-to-date QuickJS support with full cross-platform capability including Web and OpenHarmony.
Automatic type conversion and support for handles, promises, and Dart-JS function binding.
weaknesses: Synchronous execution time limits, memory limits, and stack limits throw UnsupportedError on Web.
Requires managing handles and explicitly disposing resources.
